confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings; no web search was used for city prices. Remembered levels were carried forward to July 2026 for local inflation and IDR/USD movement. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderate confidence, assuming Indonesian tax and service are included. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because rates vary widely by district, star rating and booking channel. Cocktail and wine rely on a beer-relative cross-check because direct knowledge of Jakarta bar prices is limited. FX is the RBA 15 Oct 2026 observation as returned by search; search-cached RBA page dates were inconsistent, so confirm on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian capital cities with similar hotel stock and a wide gap between local warung food and international-style restaurants, such as Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Manila. Cocktail and wine were set at roughly 2.7x and 3.0x the beer anchor, since Indonesian alcohol is heavily taxed, imported wine carries import duties, and direct bar-price knowledge is weak.
